ideas.idea: Add Disallow groups for other training crawlers (ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, CCBot, etc.)
ideas.why: geo.config.json says trainingCrawlers: block, but robots.txt only blocks GPTBot, so the other training bots are allowed by the * rule.

ideas.idea: Add explicit Allow groups for AI search bots (OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, etc.)
ideas.why: The * rule already allows them, so explicit groups change almost nothing.

ideas.idea: /api/changelog route doesn't exist, so the fetch would 404
ideas.why: No API route appears in the repo files, so this is accurate and specific to the changelog page.

ideas.idea: Add concrete plan names, prices and inclusions to the pricing copy
ideas.why: Pricing says only 'Talk to us for a quote', so there is nothing specific for people or AI answers to quote.

ideas.idea: Make the root fallback title and description descriptive and generate canonicals per route
ideas.why: The root title 'Atlas' is thin, but the advice is broad and the routes that matter already have their own meta.

ideas.idea: Add Features and Home links to the root nav
ideas.why: The root nav links only to Pricing and Changelog, so a real crawlable link to /features is missing.

ideas.idea: Name the specific integrations instead of 'all the tools you already use'
ideas.why: The home page copy is vague, and naming integrations gives readers and AI engines extractable facts.

ideas.idea: Expand the features page with one h2 section per feature
ideas.why: features.tsx has a single thin sentence, so more structured content would help readers and machines understand it.
Having no JSON-LD is a deliberate choice that isn't required, and the FAQPage suggestion is folklore.

ideas.idea: Add <lastmod> to sitemap URLs, especially the changelog
ideas.why: The sitemap has no lastmod, and a frequently updated changelog benefits from freshness signals.

ideas.idea: Add Open Graph and Twitter card tags
ideas.why: This applies to almost any site and has little effect on search or AI discovery.

ideas.idea: Add llms.txt to give AI tools a site summary
ideas.why: The report itself calls it optional, and having no llms.txt is explicitly not a problem.

ideas.idea: Add meta charset and viewport to the root head
ideas.why: root.tsx's head has only Meta and Links with no charset or viewport, which is a real gap for rendering and mobile.
